name: HiveMind
notes: Beeps you can hear through a bee suit (speaker or earpiece) as well as the buzz: listening, your turn, got it, stopped.
Dictated notes get full stops and capitals.
Hands-free marks each box in the recording, so you can jump straight to it, and a pause isn't recorded.
Settings › Listening › Your English: choose US, UK, Australian and other English.
